mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This appears to be a milk-based coffee beverage, which is relatively low in carbohydrates unless sugar or flavored syrups are added. It may have a mild effect on blood sugar levels for someone with diabetes, but sweetened versions can raise glycemic impact; it is best to avoid or strictly limit this meal, opting for an unsweetened coffee with low-fat milk or a high-fiber breakfast alternative instead.
